sentences.text: Chokher Bali -LRB- চোখের বালি literally translated to `` sand in the eye '' , figuratively to `` constant irritant '' -RRB- is a Bengali drama film based on the novel Chokher Bali by Rabindranath Tagore .	Chokher Bali	Chokher Bali (novel)	Rabindranath Tagore	Rabindranath Tagore	Bengali	Cinema of West Bengal	drama	drama
It was directed by Rituparno Ghosh in 2003 and stars Aishwarya Rai as Binodini and Raima Sen as Ashalata .	Rituparno Ghosh	Rituparno Ghosh	Aishwarya Rai	Aishwarya Rai Bachchan	Raima Sen	Raima Sen
Ashalata and Binodini refer to each other as Chokher Bali .	Chokher Bali	Chokher Bali (novel)

The other major characters are played by Prosenjit Chatterjee as Mahendra , Lily Chakravarty as Rajlakshmi , the mother of Mahendra , Tota Roy Chowdhury as Behari , Rajlakshmi 's adopted son and Swastika Mukherjee in a cameo role .	Tota Roy Chowdhury	Tota Roy Chowdhury	Prosenjit Chatterjee	Prosenjit Chatterjee	Lily Chakravarty	Lily Chakravarty	Swastika Mukherjee	Swastika Mukherjee	cameo	cameo appearance
The film was later dubbed into Hindi and was released internationally in that language .
Upon release , Chokher Bali met with positive critical and box office reception .	Chokher Bali	Chokher Bali (novel)

Chokher Bali won the National Film Award for Best Feature Film in Bengali and was nominated for the Golden Leopard -LRB- Best Film -RRB- award at the Locarno International Film Festival in 2003 .	Chokher Bali	Chokher Bali (novel)	Bengali	Cinema of West Bengal	National Film Award for Best Feature Film in Bengali	National Film Award for Best Feature Film in Bengali	Golden Leopard	Golden Leopard	Locarno International Film Festival	Locarno International Film Festival
The film screened at the 34th International Film Festival of India on 19 October .	India	India	International Film Festival of India	International Film Festival of India

It was the Official Selection at the Chicago International Film Festival in 2003 and was showcased in over 25 international festivals including the Toronto International Film Festival , London Film Festival , Palm Springs , Karlovy Vary and Washington DC International Film Festival besides winning the Apsara Film Producers ' Award for the Best Regional Film 2004 .	Chicago International Film Festival	Chicago International Film Festival	Toronto International Film Festival	Toronto International Film Festival
